files.role: Top-level summary of the research question, key findings, instruments, models, repository layout, and total API-call counts.
Authoritative source of all numeric claims, methodology, equations, and tables. Used as the primary reference for hypothesis, method, and qualitative observations.
Author-written narrative summary of the core analyses (factor collapse, PIR, variance decomposition, DIF, measurement invariance).
Source of the prompt template, persona conditions, sampling protocol (k=5, temp=0.7), and API call structure.
Full documentation of the 221-item battery (IPIP-NEO-120, SD3, ZKPQ-50-CC, EPQR-A) with per-instrument scoring keys and reverse counts.
Machine-readable battery: item text, domain, facet, keying, response format.
Aggregated scores: model x persona x scale x domain (used for downstream EFA and convergent validity).
Internal-consistency metric: Cronbach's alpha per IPIP domain across 20 models.
EFA eigenvalue spectrum on 17 domain scores (Kaiser criterion -> 3 factors).
Factor loadings on the 3-factor solution after varimax rotation.
Tucker's phi per held-out model (mean = 0.993 -> universal factor structure).
20 leave-one-model-out EFA reruns; all return 3 Kaiser factors; first eigenvalue stable 6.94-7.02.
Sequential SS decomposition of total response variance (Likert and binary).
Forward vs reverse agree rates per (model, instrument); enables Delta = Fwd - Rev.
Pairwise Inconsistency Rate per (model, domain).
Per-model PIR x SDR scatter (Spearman r = -0.562 in early run; r = 0.63 in final paper).
Cronbach's alpha for Random, Pure-Acquiescence, and Trait+Acquiescence simulated data; benchmarks LLM observed alphas.
Pearson and Spearman correlations for 8 cross-scale construct pairs.
Default-vs-MBTI Pearson correlation per (model, persona); test of measurement invariance.
PSD, empirical-cosine, theory-cosine for every (model, persona) cell.
Confusion matrix for nearest-centroid persona classification (319/320 correct).
Persona-classification accuracy under metric/scale ablations (z-Euclidean, cosine, Mahalanobis x all/likert/binary/ipip).
Sign-aligned cross-scale coherence per construct (Extraversion, Neuroticism, A-vs-Antagonism, C-vs-Disinhibition).
Per-domain regression coefficients for E/I, S/N, T/F, J/P main effects and interactions.
Per-item mean absolute shift from Default; identifies plastic vs locked items.
Within-sample consistency (mean SD across 5 repetitions) per model.
Within-sample consistency per persona (Default is the noisiest condition).
Within-sample consistency per (scale, domain).
Per-model lie-score, acquiescence bias, midpoint and extreme-response rates.
Differential Item Functioning across model families (all p > 0.16).
Side-by-side human-norm vs LLM-observed alphas.
All publication-quality PNG/PDF figures (40+ files), already produced by polish_figures.py.
Per-model run logs from run_mbti_experiment.py and backfill scripts (May 13-17, 2026).
